name: Email & Messaging Etiquette
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on email & messaging etiquette — practice these key phrases out loud:
I hope this email finds you well.
I'm writing to follow up on our earlier conversation.
Please let me know if you have any questions.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
